title: A running jump heard as a jump off the train (AU1's audio audit): GameAudio plays crew-jump-off.impact for any landing over 1.5 m/s across, so every running jump between roofs, and a running jump on open ground (with its tumble and scattered pockets), sounds like a fall off a moving train; the sim's own knock (PlayerMotor.Land) is for the ground only, less a run's speed
